entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Adriano Tomasi Travaglia is a Roman Catholic bishop serving in the Italian Church, continuing the apostolic succession in one of the Italian diocese network's many historic sees. His ministry as a bishop represents the ongoing pastoral mission of the Italian Catholic Church in the twenty-first century — maintaining the Church's presence and witness across Italy's diverse regional cultures.

The Italian Church's episcopal landscape is characterised by a large number of dioceses — Italy has more Catholic dioceses per capita than almost any other country — each with its own ancient tradition and local character. Bishops like Tomasi Travaglia serve in this varied landscape, providing pastoral leadership that responds to local needs while remaining in communion with the priorities of the Holy See and the Italian Episcopal Conference.

His episcopate reflects the Italian Church's continuing effort to maintain its apostolic mission in a society where Catholic identity remains culturally significant but active religious practice continues to decline. The challenge for Italian bishops is to maintain pastoral vitality and institutional relevance while navigating the social changes of a post-Christian generation.
